evidence.text: NVIDIA fiscal 2026 revenue was $215.9 billion, up 65% year on year.
Data Center revenue was $193.7 billion, up 68% year on year.
Gaming revenue was $16.0 billion, up 41% year on year.
Gross margin decreased; the filing says it was also affected by a $4.5 billion H20 excess-inventory and purchase-obligation charge.
